1_recognition.title: Imagine
1_recognition.transcript: Imagine there's no heaven, it's easy if you try. No hell below us, above us only sky.
1_recognition.reasoning: The spoken lyrics are a verbatim match to the opening verse of John Lennon's iconic song.
